'''Theorem.''' Every group of prime order is cyclic.

'''Proof.''' Take an element that is not the identity.

;Lemma 2
:If {{math|''p''}} divides {{math|{{abs|''G''}}}}, then {{mvar|G}} has an element of order {{mvar|p}}.
{{collapse top|title=Proof}}
By induction.
{{collapse bottom}}
{{NumBlk|:|<math>a^p \equiv a \pmod p</math>|{{EquationRef|1}}}}
By {{EquationNote|1}}, the claim holds.
